chunks: And from him, from Ibn Mahbub, from Abu Ayyub, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:

A caller will call out from the sky with the name of the Qaim (peace be upon him), and it will be heard from the East to the West; no one remaining seated will not stand up, and no one standing will not sit down, and no one sitting will not stand up on his legs because of that voice, and it is the voice of Jibreel (Gabriel), the Trustworthy Spirit.

key_terms.الْقَائِمُ: The Rising One, a title for Imam al-Mahdi (a.s.)

ai.seo_question: What is the voice that awakens all humanity before the reappearance of Imam Mahdi?
ai.summary: In Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Kitab al-Ghayba*, this narration identifies the caller as Jibril (Gabriel), emphasizing the cosmic scale of the announcement that reaches from East to West. This auditory sign serves as a universal summons, compelling all humanity to rise or sit in immediate, involuntary response, thereby marking the definitive transition from the era of occultation to the Imam’s visible reign.
